messages:
alex: Heads-up: seeing persistent KV memory growth on host-gpu-42 during longctx replay (10k tokens). Not a leak in tensor arena — KV resident pages climb across requests.

nina: @alex can you paste the tail of the allocator/profiler? rough timeline?

alex: here — saw after ~3h of mixed chat workloads:
```
kv_resident_pages=8421 -> 12134
prefix_cache_entries=18k
avg_prefix_size=92 bytes
eviction_ops/sec=0.6
compaction_runs=2
```

kevin: interesting — eviction_ops/sec low while resident grows = fragmentation + pinned spans. any session affinity changes rolled?

alex: we enabled "anchor-salting" for tenant routing last week (to reduce cross-tenant collisions). suspect salted keys prevent prefix coalescing.

jeremy: anchor-salting changed cache key to `{tenant}:{session}:{prefix_hash}:{salt}` right? that salt is per-request; that'll stop reuse.

alex: exactly. earlier key was `{tenant}:{prefix}` for small prefixes. salt added at routing layer to avoid tenant fingerprinting.

lia: that matches profiling: kernel selection not related. Batching looks normal. KV lookup hit-rate dropped 7% after salt flip.

nina: can we patch to make salt optional for prefix-keys only? keep salt for full-request keying.

kevin: proposal: two-tier keying: stable prefix_key = `tenant:prefix:session_opt` (no salt) and request_key = full salted key. Eviction TTL for prefix_key shorter and can be sticky.

alex: also saw many tiny allocations in page directory when prefix_key duplicated -> compaction thrash.

jeremy: we should run small canary: revert anchor-salting for prefix flow on one hostpool and measure resident delta in 24h.

infra-bot: Scheduled job: run canary revert on pool 'longctx-canary' starting 2026-03-19T02:30Z — job id cf-8812

lia: canary SGTM. add metric: `kv.prefix_reuse_ratio` and `kv.fragmentation_ratio` to dashboards.

nina: i'll add a smoke test to assert prefix_cache_hit_rate >= 75% under longctx load.

kevin: also note: prefix normalization lowercased earlier; ensure salt doesn't change normalization step ordering.

alex: action items:
- nina: add smoke test + dashboard alerts
- jeremy: deploy canary revert
- kevin: patch two-tier keying RFC (short PR)
- lia: add compaction/op counters to perftrace

alex: thanks. ping me if canary shows immediate improvement. :eyes:
